definitions.explanation: A temperature that is notably high. Used in weather reports, cooking, science, and safety warnings. The opposite is {低温|ていおん}.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{高温|こうおん}⟦{注意報|ちゅういほう}→注意報：16464_chuuihou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}ている→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: A high temperature warning has been issued today.

examples.japanese: {高温|こうおん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{焼|や}く→焼く：01123_yaku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧パリッ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{仕上|しあ}がる→仕上がる：11429_shiagaru⟧。
examples.english: Baking at high temperature gives a crispy finish.

examples.japanese: {高温|こうおん}⟦{多湿|たしつ}→多湿：12310_tashitsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{環境|かんきょう}→環境：00174_kankyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{食品|しょくひん}→食品：03247_shokuhin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{傷|いた}み→傷む：10061_itamu⟧やすい⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{冷蔵庫|れいぞうこ}→冷蔵庫：01046_reizouko⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{保管|ほかん}して→保管する：25536_hokansuru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Food spoils easily in hot and humid conditions, so please store it in the refrigerator.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{高|こう}→高〜：03951_kou⟧ (high) + {温|おん} (temperature). Very common in weather reports, product labels, and safety instructions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {高温|こうおん}⟦{多湿|たしつ}→多湿：12310_tashitsu⟧ (hot and humid)
- {高温|こうおん}⟦{注意報|ちゅういほう}→注意報：16464_chuuihou⟧ (high temperature warning)
- {高温|こうおん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{焼|や}く→焼く：01123_yaku⟧ (bake at high temperature)
- {高温|こうおん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧ (caution: high temperature)
- {高温|こうおん}⟦{殺菌|さっきん}→殺菌：09781_sakkin⟧ (high-temperature sterilization)

SIMILAR WORDS:
The opposite is ⟦{低温|ていおん}→低温：29339_teion⟧ (low temperature). ⟦{猛暑|もうしょ}→猛暑：08311_mousho⟧ (extreme heat) specifically refers to weather, while {高温|こうおん} is used more broadly for any context involving high temperature.
